login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Manage your Axentra platform.
login.sessionEnded: Please sign in to continue where you left off.

invitation.title: Sign in to accept your invitation
invitation.body: Use the account for the email address the invitation was sent to.
invitation.confirmNextPage: You confirm the invitation on the next page.
invitation.confirmOrSso: Signing in with a password, you confirm the invitation on the next page; with single sign-on, it is accepted as soon as you are signed in.
invitation.acceptedAtSso: It is accepted as soon as you are signed in.
invitation.noAccountSso: No account yet? Sign in with single sign-on using the invited address: the server creates your account because an invitation is open for it.
invitation.noAccountPassword: No account yet? This server has no sign-up: ask the person who invited you or an administrator to create one for the invited address.

login.invalidBody: The email address or password is incorrect.
login.noMethodsBody: The server has neither password sign-in nor single sign-on enabled. Ask your administrator to configure authentication.

ssoErrors.login_expired: The sign-in took too long, or it was started in another browser. Start it again from this page.
ssoErrors.access_denied: The identity provider reports that the sign-in was cancelled or consent was refused.
ssoErrors.provider_unavailable: The identity provider could not be reached or is not configured correctly. Try again later or contact your administrator.
ssoErrors.login_failed: The identity provider's answer could not be verified. Try again; if this keeps happening, contact your administrator.
ssoErrors.email_not_verified: Your identity provider did not confirm that your email address is verified. This server needs a verified address.
ssoErrors.domain_not_allowed: Your email domain is not allowed for this sign-in method.
ssoErrors.signup_disabled: There is no account for you on this server yet. Ask an administrator for an invitation, then sign in again.
ssoErrors.explicit_link_required: This sign-in method is not linked to your account yet. Accounts with platform rights are never linked automatically: ask a platform administrator to link your sign-in method, then sign in again.
ssoErrors.account_disabled: Your account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
ssoErrors.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts from your network. Wait a minute and try again.
ssoErrors.invitation_requires_post: This single sign-on link carried an invitation, which Axentra only accepts from this sign-in page. Open the invitation link from your email again and sign in here.
ssoErrors.unknown: The sign-in failed (code “{{code}}”). Try again or contact your administrator.

setup.title: Set up Axentra
setup.subtitle: Create the first platform administrator. This page is only available until setup is complete.
setup.tokenHelp: Print a one-time token on the server with
setup.passwordHelp: At least {{min}} characters. Not your email address.
setup.successBody: You are now signed in as platform administrator.
setup.tokenInfo: The token is valid for 60 minutes by default, works only once and only while no platform administrator exists. Treat it like a password.
setup.emailHelp: You sign in with this address. It must not belong to another account.
setup.passwordInfo: The server checks the password: at least {{min}} characters (set by the operator, 12 by default), at most {{max}} characters, not equal to the email address, and at least 4 different characters.
setup.tokenInvalidBody: The token is wrong, expired or already used. Create a new one on the server and try again.
setup.alreadyDoneBody: A platform administrator already exists on this server.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email address of your account. If it can sign in with a password, you get a link to choose a new one.
forgot.emailHelp: The link works once and expires after a short time.
forgot.sentBody: If an account with a password exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. It can take a few minutes; check your spam folder too. Accounts that sign in with single sign-on only get no link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Set the new password for your account.
reset.sessionsNote: Saving signs you out everywhere, this browser included. Then sign in with the new password.
reset.successBody: Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: The link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Only the newest link of an account works.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.subtitle: Confirm that this email address belongs to you.
verify.doneBody: Thank you. Your profile now shows the address as verified.
verify.invalidBody: The link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Send a new one from your profile.
